/poll question: Monk/Rogue Class Tweaks: Slow Fall for Monks (Rank 10) by cairo
text:
Author: cairo
Post: https://discord.com/channels/766364534495117383/1286801164326797385/1564414593269235724
Doc: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vHBgdi_ghIrJmUNW1aaz6khzHkt2noKLyHsBTl26RbY/edit?usp=sharing>
Summary:
- Monks gain Slow Fall at Rank 10: no damage from jumping or falling off fortification walls.
- Chi Block at Rank 20 can be performed with an open hand as well as with Monk Hands.
- At Rank 20, Monks learn Freedom of Movement instead of Evasion — Big Game Hunter effects plus immunity to Hold spells and effects.
- Evasion becomes Rogue-only: duration changes from Permanent to Instant, and resting for 60 seconds regains it.
- New fortification rule — jumping or falling from a fortification wall causes a light wound to each leg (the damage Slow Fall negates) — and a new Monk relic, Earthquake: a quarterstaff that strikes per Shield Break and deals magical damage (magical yellow only when wielded one-handed).
answer-1: Yes
answer-2: No
answer-3: Abstain

Wording flag from the doc read: the Intent summary describes the Chi Block change as a foot option, but the operative proposed wording says an open hand. In the discussion thread cairo said he is open to sections of the proposal being voted as line items. Rationale in the doc: give Monks different flavor and class utility; the fortification rule codifies a long-played practice; no substantive rationale is stated for the Evasion change.
